component.name: Yacr
component.summary: Cross-platform open-source CAD for DWG/DXF drawings
面向 DWG/DXF 图纸的跨平台开源 CAD

description.p: Yacr is a cross-platform open-source CAD project. A shared Rust core handles DWG/DXF documents, geometry and rendering; React + Tauri provides the desktop UI. It opens local DWG/DXF drawings and shows model space and supported layouts. Linux is the only runnable GUI today; the other hosts are still in development.
Yacr 是一个跨平台开源 CAD 项目：共享的 Rust 核心负责 DWG/DXF 文档、几何与渲染， React + Tauri 提供桌面界面。它可打开本地 DWG/DXF 图纸，查看模型空间与受支持的布局。 Linux 是目前唯一可运行的 GUI，其他宿主仍在开发中。
